title: Garnet had never been confirmed in a Martian meteorite until researchers examining NWA 8171 at the Royal Ontario Museum found andradite inside a fragment smaller than one millimetre. Some surrounding minerals carry Martian chemistry, but scientists cannot yet tell whether it records an unknown magma, ancient fluid alteration, metamorphism—or debris from an asteroid that struck Mars.
description: Andradite in the NWA 8171 Martian breccia is secure, but its tiny host clast could record Martian magma, alteration, metamorphism or material delivered by an impactor. title: Gondwana Was Bigger Than We Thought: Hidden Continents Reveal How an Ancient Supercontinent May Have Fueled Life
description: Scientists used more than 25,000 rock samples to identify hidden continental fragments, suggesting Gondwana once covered about 80% of Earth's present continental landmass.
